key.qwantiumbot.lock_target: Fight the player you look at
qwantiumbot.msg.not_allowed: The PvP bot only works in your singleplayer/LAN world or on servers that run the Qwantium PvP Bot mod.
qwantiumbot.msg.unknown_difficulty: Unknown difficulty: %s (easy, normal, hard, crazy, quantum)
qwantiumbot.help:
/qbot on|off|toggle|status
/qbot difficulty easy|normal|hard|crazy|quantum
/qbot target nearest|mobs|<player>
/qbot quantum on|off  (Quantum's map bot plays you)
/qbot autorespawn true|false
/qbot range <4-64>
Keys: R = on/off, H = fight the player you look at, J = difficulty
qwantiumbot.hud.waiting: Qwantium bot: waiting for an opponent
qwantiumbot.quantum.on: Quantum control ON: the bot of Quantum's PvP Practice map now plays your character. Type /qbot quantum off to take back control.
qwantiumbot.quantum.off: Quantum control OFF: you control your character again.
qwantiumbot.quantum.no_herobot: Quantum control needs HeroBot (and Quantum's map) on the server or in your world.
qwantiumbot.quantum.no_server_mod: Quantum control needs the Qwantium PvP Bot mod on the server (or your own singleplayer/LAN world).
qwantiumbot.quantum.pack_enabled: Turned on the Qwantium bridge datapack (data reloaded).
qwantiumbot.quantum.requested: Asking the server for Quantum control...
